data.title: Exploring Four-Digit Place Value
data.description: Learn how to read and understand place value in four-digit whole numbers using thousands, hundreds, tens, and ones.

challenges.instruction: What number do these blocks show?
challenges.hint: Check each column carefully, especially the tens place where there might be zero blocks.

challenges.instruction: What number do these blocks show?
challenges.hint: Count the thousands, hundreds, tens, and ones separately.

challenges.instruction: What number do these blocks show?
challenges.hint: Pay close attention to the empty columns when reading the total value.

challenges.instruction: What number do these blocks show?
challenges.hint: Combine the values of all the blocks on the mat to find the total.
